name: agentscm-status-ui
description: Read-only status page served by the AgentSCM coordination hub at /ui/.

scripts.lint: eslint . && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-derive.mjs && npm run test:connect-agent && npm run test:workspace && npm run test:standup

dependencyNotes.react: UI runtime. 18.x because antd 5 supports React 16 to 18.
dependencyNotes.antd: Component library (cards, tags, tooltips, dropdown, segmented, skeleton) and theme tokens for light/dark.
dependencyNotes.@ant-design/icons: Icon set used by antd and the header, rows and timeline.
dependencyNotes.vite: Dev server and bundler producing dist/index.html, app.js, app.css. Built-in JSX transform, so no React plugin.
dependencyNotes.typescript: Strict type checking (tsc -b). Held below 6.1 for typescript-eslint.
dependencyNotes.@types/node: Types for vite.config.ts and the Node scripts.
dependencyNotes.typescript-eslint: TypeScript parser and rules for ESLint.
dependencyNotes.globals: Browser and Node global names for the flat ESLint config.
